name: Foreshadow Industries
long_description: We turn existing military systems into intelligent machine. Our AI model (Zulu) is designed to natively reason over space and time. That is what enables long duration missions. Zulu is trained to operate maritime vessels, airplanes, ground vehicles and satellites. We have integrated it with military vessels and demonstrated long-duration missions over an entire period of darkness, multiple times, and on two vessels simultaneously. Founded by former SpaceX & Anduril Engineers.
one_liner: Defense robotics built on AI models that reason over space and time

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: Foreshadow is the culmination of a career spent on critical national security applications of AI, including at Anduril and SpaceX. The difference between what is available at intel agencies / command centers and what is available to forward operators is staggering. It is a problem I observed, experienced, came to deeply understand, and needed to solve.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: YC has the highest density of talented and ambitious founders. I wanted to normalize working on national security and connect with other founders in YC help solve on the most critical challenges facing our nation.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Defense AI capabilities live in command centers and rely on remote operations that disappear when jammed. We are building true AI systems that operate at the edge, for warfighters on the frontlines. I have seen the problem firsthand.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer:
We are going to take our model and bake it onto a chip. This is the enabler for the new type of artificial intelligence needed for national security: one that can act with foresight. It will allow us to tackle the highest-value missions. We plan to go from small maritime vessels to a destroyer, to an aircraft carrier, to an entire carrier strike group.

Most AI and robotics companies are focused on automating labor. We take a different approach: we look at what missions and job scenarios are too dangerous for us to even send people to do, and how we could safely do those operations with robots. That protects our forces and creates additional strategic options for national security. We will eventually go to the commercial sector too, but national security is the crucible where we forge this new type of intelligence.
